description:
[Ellen Shim](https://www.mangaupdates.com/authors.html?id=41626) has published a series of cartoon on her Twitter since 2014, organizing it and making her debut in 2015 with the publish of this work.

A peaceful village where rats live together. One night, Dugger finds Nancy, a baby cat wrapped in a blanket, abandoned in front of his house. Nancy likes pink ribbon hairpin, she likes princess play more than ball play. Delicate and hearty cat Nancy, and who is worried that she is too fat than her friends. Jimmy, a strong brother who wants to protect his little sister. Friendly village mice. And each of them is full of school friends. Everything is special with Nancy, even for your everyday life! A beautiful fairy-tale cartoon about a family and friendship that transcends races of cats and mice with a smile on the people's mouths as they read.

[Original Comic (eBook)](https://ridibooks.com/books/593000453)
